name: cbp-python-stack
description: The Python/FastAPI stack toolbox (#187 distribution pilot, second Tier-2 stack pack): framework-aware helpers the workflow plugins pick up automatically in Python backends — pytest-dev test-runner know-how, fastapi-run-backend-tests, fastapi-db-migrate (Alembic), fastapi-deploy, plus the FastAPI API-tester and database-admin agents. Install alongside cbp-build-test-workflows so test-pipeline uses the stack-aware path.
